experiment: Independence diagnostics after a cutoff horizon
notes: Reuses all 600 saved Humanoid trajectories, without simulation or training.
For each cutoff p, apply the original three test functions to observations at iterations p+1,...,150.
Same fixed lag 5, 4999 resamples per test, 1% significance, and BDS coordinate Bonferroni correction as the original prefix comparison.
The Gaussian bandwidth and BDS epsilon are recomputed within each retained window using the original rules.
These pointwise iid-null diagnostics can reject because of serial dependence or changing marginal distributions. Later cutoffs shorten the sample and reduce power.
No correction across trajectories or overlapping cutoffs; the output is the descriptive proportion of rejected trajectories.
window: global iterations cutoff+1 through the final saved iteration
